assertions.claim: Thrombolysis within 3 hours gives ~1.75× odds of recovering to basic self-care; 3–4.5h drops to 1.26×; beyond 4.5h no visible difference.
assertions.cn_span: 3 小时内溶栓，恢复到生活基本能自理的概率大约是不溶栓的 1.75 倍

assertions.claim: Beyond 4.5 hours OR 1.15 (0.95–1.40), no longer significant (6756 patients, 16 trials, alteplase).
Call 120 immediately, note exact symptom-onset time, no water/medication, don't drive yourself.
assertions.cn_span: 记下症状开始的准确时间，别喂水喂药，别自己开车

assertions.claim: 120 instead of own car because the ambulance goes straight to a stroke-center hospital and alerts it in advance.
assertions.cn_span: 救护车会直接送到有卒中中心的医院并提前通知
